baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive يُصْهَرُ and the coordination of what is in the bellies with the skins.
baseline_models.mechanism: One instrument-driven phase change spans a nested body: contained matter and enclosing surface become co-objects, so the inside/outside boundary does not limit the action.

activation_trace.role: Heat-induced liquefaction supplies the passive operation that unforms bodily matter.
The inside and what it contains supply the inner layer reached by the operation.
The bodily covering supplies the outer layer coordinated with the inner contents.

changed_reading.before: The ayah lists damage to viscera and skin as two bodily effects.
changed_reading.after: The ayah presents one penetrating phase change that collapses a body's contents and enclosing surface as a single material system.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The juxtaposition of melting with الْجُلُودُ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Skin can carry toughness, compact solidity, and even frozen or curdled density; placed under melting, it marks resistant bodily coherence specifically losing its phase and endurance.

activation_trace.role: Melting by heat supplies the reversal of solidity rather than mere surface contact.
Hardness and endurance make skin the body's resistant shell in the model.
Frozen or curdled density supplies a phase-state image that melting directly reverses.

changed_reading.before: Skin is merely another passive body part struck by heat.
changed_reading.after: Skin names the body's capacity to remain hard and coherent, and the melting specifically negates that toughness rather than only scorching its surface.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مَا فِى بُطُونِهِمْ set beside وَٱلْجُلُودُ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The belly branch can mark concealed inwardness while skin is the visible bodily envelope; the coordination subjects hidden and manifest layers to the same unmaking.

activation_trace.role: Hidden inwardness makes the belly phrase more than a neutral anatomical location.
The body's exposed covering supplies the manifest counterpart to the concealed interior.
A single melting operation equalizes the fate of concealed and exposed matter.

changed_reading.before: The phrase denotes literal organs and literal skin.
changed_reading.after: Without ceasing to be anatomical, it also removes the distinction between a protected hidden interior and an exposed exterior: neither layer remains insulated.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier context builds embodied form inside a concealed bearer through liquid, clinging or congealed matter, flesh-like matter, and completed formation in a womb. The focus reverses that trajectory: heat returns formed inner matter and its envelope toward loss of form.

activation_trace.role: The containing belly keeps the reversal anchored in the focus's embodied interior.
Thermal liquefaction supplies the terminal unforming operation.
A hidden pregnancy or fruit supplies the model of an interior bearing developing matter.
A drop-like generative liquid supplies the earliest low-coherence bodily state.
Thick congealed blood supplies a phase of matter gaining attachment and density.
The flesh-like morsel supplies a further stage of bodily material differentiation.
Completed formation and proportion supply the coherent form that melting later negates.
The womb supplies the protected interior in which the constructive sequence occurs.

structural_cues: 22:2 foregrounds a carried interior, and 22:5 orders bodily states from a drop through formed creation before the focus later liquefies what is inside bodies.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a constructive sequence of embodied phases and the focus supplies thermal dissolution; I infer a reverse-formation arrow from the former to the latter. A live alternative is that the earlier sequence proves re-creation while the focus only describes bodily pain, without a designed reversal.

changed_reading.before: The heat indiscriminately melts pre-existing bodily contents.
changed_reading.after: The melting can be read as reverse embodiment: matter earlier shown gathering, attaching, differentiating, and taking form inside a protected interior is driven back toward formlessness together with its skin.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly gives descending water a life-making vector: it is delivered from above, stirs dead ground, produces growth, and makes earth green. Immediately before the focus, a heated liquid follows the same downward vector but dissolves differentiated bodily form, making it an ecological reversal of rain.

activation_trace.role: Liquefaction supplies the destructive result opposed to rain's animation and growth.
Water delivered by watering or pouring supplies the productive liquid motion.
The earth and plants stirring into life supply the first positive outcome of descent.
Growth emerging from earth supplies differentiation and formed life after water.
Pouring supplies the destructive liquid's motion into the focus.
The upper direction makes the hot liquid structurally parallel to descending rain.
Hot water supplies the altered thermal state that reverses water's usual effect.
Melting fat links the descending hot medium directly to loss of internal bodily form.
A repeated descent of water later in the surah reinforces the productive downward vector.
Ordinary water supplies the unheated counterpart to the focus's instrument.
Green living growth supplies the later positive result contrasted with bodily dissolution.

structural_cues: Descending water animates earth at 22:5 and 22:63, while 22:19 places poured hot water from above directly before the focus's melting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated water descent, opposite life and melting outcomes, and an immediate hot-water antecedent; I infer that the focus functions as anti-rain, a reversal of productive descent. The alternative is that shared direction and liquid are incidental across independent resurrection and punishment scenes.

changed_reading.before: A hot fluid burns and melts the body.
changed_reading.after: The fluid is destructive anti-rain: the surah's life-making descent is thermally reversed so that a medium which elsewhere raises and differentiates life here dissolves both inner matter and its outer form.

context_deltas.mechanism: Contextual fitna carries the image of assaying both metal and people: one trial turns a surface-oriented worshiper over, and another exposes diseased and hardened hearts. That sequence activates melting as a terminal destructive assay in which concealed interior and resistant surface can no longer maintain different presentations.

activation_trace.role: Heat-liquefaction supplies the assay-like material operation.
Hidden inwardness supplies what the assay makes unable to remain concealed.
Surface hardness supplies the resistance tested and overcome.
Assaying metal and testing a person supplies the bridge from trial to thermal revelation.
Turning a thing from its face supplies a visible reversal under trial.
The repeated human-and-metal assay image extends testing to the later heart sequence.
The heart supplies the explicitly named inward faculty exposed by the test.
Departure from health supplies one concealed condition disclosed by testing.
Hardness of heart supplies the inward rigidity echoed by the focus's resistant skin.

structural_cues: 22:11 links trial to bodily inversion, while 22:53 links trial to diseased and hardened hearts; the focus lies between these two assay scenes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fitna's metal/person assay branch, bodily inversion, hidden heart conditions, and literal melting; I infer that the thermal scene realizes testing as destructive disclosure. The alternative is that fitna remains a separate moral category and contributes no assay mechanism to the focus.

changed_reading.before: Melting is physical destruction with no revelatory function.
changed_reading.after: Melting also behaves as a terminal assay: it defeats both the body's hard presentation and its concealed condition, materially exposing that neither can preserve a separate state under the test.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding ayah constructs an imposed outer garment and then sends hot liquid from above the heads. The focus's بِهِ takes that medium forward and reports its path-completing effect across skin and belly contents, converting a list of injuries into a directed outside-to-inside breach.

activation_trace.role: Liquefaction supplies the consequence of the preceding poured medium.
The contained interior supplies the endpoint of penetration.
The bodily covering supplies the boundary crossed on the way inward.
Cutting or tailoring cloth supplies a fitted fabricated layer around the body.
Clothing that can stand for the person supplies an imposed outer envelope.
Pouring supplies the force and continuity of the penetrating medium.
The upper direction fixes the start of the path.
The head as bodily top localizes where the downward breach begins.
Hot water identifies the instrument carried forward by the focus's pronoun.
Melting fat supplies a branch-level bridge from the poured medium to internal liquefaction.

structural_cues: 22:19 immediately precedes the focus, supplies a singular hot poured medium, and fixes its source above the heads; 22:20 begins with a passive verb and بِهِ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the fitted fire-garment, downward hot-water vector, and the focus's instrumental pronoun; I infer that the listed skin and belly effects are stages of penetration. A live alternative is that skin and interior are simultaneous effects without a represented path.

changed_reading.before: Interior and skin melt in a non-directional catalogue of bodily damage.
changed_reading.after: An imposed outer layer is followed by a hot descent from the body's top, and the focus shows that descent breaching the natural skin boundary and reaching the contained interior.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequel adds hard instruments, attempted exit, enclosing distress, forced return, and burning. Melting therefore sits inside a recursively maintained apparatus: heat traverses inward, while movement outward is repelled and reversed.

activation_trace.role: Liquefaction supplies the bodily process maintained inside the loop.
The bodily inside supplies one side of the loop's spatial opposition.
The body's resistant boundary supplies what repeated heat prevents from recovering.
Subduing and repelling supplies the force that turns attempted escape back.
Iron solidity supplies the hard external apparatus opposed to the liquefying body.
Passage to the outside supplies the attempted reverse traversal of the boundary.
Covering and enclosure supply the condition from which exit is attempted.
Return after departure closes and repeats the confinement cycle.
Flame maintains the thermal environment after forced return.

structural_cues: The immediate sequel's كُلَّمَا ... أُعِيدُوا makes recurrence explicit and places attempted exit after the focus's inward-reaching melt.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hard repulsion, exit, enclosure, return, and renewed burning directly after the focus; I infer that these form one recurrent containment apparatus. The alternative is that 22:22 describes punishment broadly rather than the repetition of each melting episode.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes a single completed thermal event.
changed_reading.after: The event belongs to a maintained loop: heat breaches inward, attempted movement outward is repelled and returned, and the body is denied any stable restoration of its skin/interior boundary.

context_deltas.mechanism: Fire clothing precedes the focus and silk clothing follows the punishment sequence. The skin branch itself can become a stripped leather covering or garment, so the focus turns natural skin into the hinge between hostile imposed clothing and intact rewarded clothing.

activation_trace.role: Flayed skin used as stuffing or clothing supplies the body's natural covering as an apparel layer.
Melting distinguishes this loss of natural clothing from ordinary removal or undressing.
Clothing and its use for the person supply the hostile outer layer before the focus.
Covering by clothing supplies the intact apparel counterpart after the punishment scene.
Fine silk supplies the materially opposite garment to fire and liquefied skin.

structural_cues: The focus is positioned after garments made from fire at 22:19 and before the contrasting silk garment at 22:23.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies clothing on both sides of the scene and a focus branch where skin becomes garment material; I infer that skin serves as a natural second garment at the hinge. The alternative is simple repetition of apparel vocabulary without a body-as-garment relation.

changed_reading.before: Skin is only an anatomical target beneath a garment of fire.
changed_reading.after: Skin is the body's own fate-bearing garment: set between imposed fire-clothing and intact silk, it is not merely stripped but liquefied, destroying the natural layer through which the person appears.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sacrificial sequence explicitly contrasts flesh and blood, which do not reach, with taqwa, which does. That distinction constrains an easy allegory in which whatever is inside the focus's bellies directly equals moral inwardness: the melted inside remains destructible bodily matter even while other models may use hidden/visible structure analogically.

activation_trace.role: Literal contained anatomy supplies the reading being protected from over-allegorization.
Literal bodily covering completes the focus's material inventory.
Reaching supplies the explicit relation by which material and taqwa receive different outcomes.
Flesh supplies a named component of bodily interior that is denied ethical reach.
Blood as bodily matter extends the explicit material inventory.
Flowing blood keeps the split root's second mapped target visible as bodily liquid.
Making the self a protection supplies the non-anatomical counterpart that the source calls reaching.

structural_cues: 22:37 grammatically opposes flesh and blood to taqwa through the repeated verb يَنَالَ, creating an explicit material/nonmaterial distinction later in the same surah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the explicit non-reaching flesh and blood versus reaching taqwa; I let that contrast constrain figurative transfer back onto the focus's bodily interior. The alternative is that a ritual-material distinction at 22:37 does not govern the punishment image at all.

changed_reading.before: The hidden contents of the bellies can directly stand for inward moral reality.
changed_reading.after: The surah's own flesh-and-blood contrast weakens that equation: the focus first names exhaustible anatomy, while ethical inwardness remains distinguishable from the viscera being melted.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later holding construction has a branch image of skin retaining what is inside it. Read back into the focus's coordination of belly contents and skins, melting becomes failure of the containing membrane, not merely injury to two adjacent tissues.

activation_trace.role: Skin as bodily covering supplies the membrane that normally encloses the person.
What is inside supplies the load retained by that membrane.
Melting supplies the inverse of holding by destroying the membrane's material coherence.
A skin that holds what is inside supplies the exact containment relation latent in the focus.

structural_cues: 22:65 predicates holding of the sky so that it does not fall, while its root inventory explicitly includes skin retaining its contents.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cosmic holding and the branch image of skin holding contents; I infer that the focus's melting is an inverse unholding of the bodily container. The alternative is that the skin branch is only a lexical analogy with no whole-surah structural force.

changed_reading.before: Heat independently reaches an interior target and an exterior target.
changed_reading.after: The skin is a load-bearing container for what is inside; when it melts, bodily holding itself fails and content and boundary cease to remain structurally distinct.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the nounal cistern branch of ص ه ر and maps ruined civic architecture onto anatomy rather than glossing the focus verb directly. It remains anchored in the same focus root, belly-as-interior, skin-as-envelope, and 22:45's branches for a collecting vessel, hollow belly, roof, well, and enclosed building. Downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory spatial analogy, never as a replacement meaning for يُصْهَرُ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The same ص ه ر root can name a water cistern, while the focus coordinates an interior belly-space with an enclosing skin.

activation_trace.role: A built cistern that gathers and restrains water supplies the cross-domain hydraulic frame.
The belly as inside and container supplies the body's reservoir-space.
The bodily covering supplies the reservoir wall or architectural envelope.
A vessel collecting water or food lets the ruined settlement operate as a container image.
A hollow belly directly bridges civic emptiness and emptied bodily interior.
The raised roof supplies the upper enclosing boundary of the ruined structure.
The abandoned well reinforces the image of a failed water-holding cavity.
An enclosed building supplies the bounded shell whose integrity can outlast or fail its contents.

changed_reading.before: A human body is melted by a hot liquid.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the body becomes ruined hydraulic architecture: belly as reservoir and skin as wall or roof lose their distinction under a poured medium, echoing an emptied settlement and disabled well.

strongest_changes: The immediate 22:19 sequence turns the focus from a non-directional injury list into a top-down breach from imposed garment through natural skin to contained interior.
Gestational formation and life-giving descending water activate two distinct reversals: reverse embodiment and destructive anti-rain.
The fitna and hardened-heart sequence adds a terminal-assay reading, while 22:37's flesh-and-blood contrast constrains any simple equation of viscera with moral inwardness.
The holding branch at 22:65 makes skin a containing membrane, so its melting is failure of bodily coherence rather than damage to an isolated surface.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet activated coherent crossings among gestation, rainfall, metallurgy, clothing, ritual material, and containment, while the immediate context fixed the literal instrument and direction strongly enough to keep those crossings anchored.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether reverse embodiment and anti-rain are designed inter-ayah structures or productive analogies generated by repeated material sequences.
How much hidden/visible moral force ب ط ن can carry after the surah explicitly distinguishes flesh and blood from taqwa.
Whether the cistern and ruined-architecture outlier remains useful outside a deliberately branch-sensitive reading.
